# E-M10 om10mi-mods: RAW white balance in Lightroom Classic (user report)

A user reports RAWs opening about 300 K lower in Lightroom Classic than set in camera; not linked to the mod.

**physical camera; inconclusive; partial report; release label only.**

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M10 (Mark I)](../cameras/em10.md) · **Project:** [om10mi-mods](../projects/om10mi-mods.md)

**Firmware:** Not recorded · **Mod build:** Not specified

**Provenance:** firsthand tester report. **Reported:** 2026-11-20. **Test date:** Not explicitly recorded.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Shot RAW at 5400 K and 5600 K in camera and opened the files in Lightroom Classic.

- Lightroom Classic showed 5100 K and 5300 K.

## Limits and assumptions

- No body, firmware or build stated, no comparison with stock firmware, and no maintainer reply when read.
- A raw converter's temperature reading can differ from the camera's setting on stock firmware too; not established as a mod effect.
- Camera recorded as the E-M10 Mark I because the project targets only that body; the report does not say so.
